hook.line: Here are seven secret codes for Claude.
hook.visual: Top half: an AI-made product site ('Can you believe Claude did this'); red '7 Secret Codes For Claude' banner with warning signs; bottom: her at a podcast mic.

beats.what: Split screen: AI-generated product page above, host at a podcast mic below, promise of seven codes.
Flash cut to black with a yellow 'number one is' caption, then back to her.
Full-screen Claude chat recording: a slash command is typed before the prompt.
Back to her for 'number two is artifacts'.
Screen recording: Claude builds a working tic-tac-toe game in the chat.
Code three: Claude 'calls out' the real reason behind a question, typed in the chat box.
Code four on screen: a long Claude answer that critiques instead of agreeing.
Zoom punch into the code-five framework diagram in the chat.
Last code shown as an orange italic title card over her shot.
Back on her: keep an eye on this account for AI and finance news.

why_it_works: 'Secret codes' plus a number makes a list with a hidden-knowledge twist; viewers stay to collect all seven.
Every code is proven with a screen recording of the actual chat within seconds of being named, so claims look demonstrated.
Very fast pacing (33.6 cuts/min, shots 1.73 s median) alternates face and screen so the eye never rests on one shot.
Short, save-worthy list content: 4,451 shares on 210k plays.
weaknesses: Most 'codes' are just words typed into the prompt; the 'secret' framing oversells them and invites doubt.
Small text: 2% median text height, and the chat screenshots are hard to read on a phone.
The closing follow ask is for 'AI and finance', a different topic from the video.
for_robert: Prove each claim on screen right after saying it: cut from Robert to a 2-3 s screen recording of the result, with Fred pointing at the key line.
